name: creative-nonfiction
description:
Writes creative nonfiction including personal essays, memoir excerpts, literary journalism, and narrative nonfiction using literary techniques applied to true events and experiences.
Use when the user asks to write a personal essay, memoir piece, narrative nonfiction, literary essay, or true story told with literary craft.
Do NOT use for academic essays (use academic-argument), blog posts (use blog-post-writing), journalism without literary intent (not a creative skill), or fiction (use short-story-writing).
